title: Answer
description:
The cloud of witnesses bears witness to the promise they did not yet see. They are not there chiefly so that we may watch them.

Jesus is the author and finisher of faith. For the joy set before Him He endured the cross, despised the shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God. The suffering and the throne are one path.

Discipline is a father speaking to sons. If it is endured, God is dealing with sons. Sonship and stripes belong together.

Hands that hang down and knees that are feeble are to be lifted, so that what is lame is not turned aside.

A root of bitterness is a turning away from the living God. It troubles many, and it bears a bitter fruit.

A profane man sold his birthright for a meal. He sought the blessing later and could not retrieve it. What is sought too late is refused.
